entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...So what did you need to talk about?[n]I thought I asked you not to come back[n]here...

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Oh, Doctor! Doctor! ...And you, too!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yes?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: I wanted to speak with you right away!

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: The hospital that was on the news is the[n]same one you used to work at, right!?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: The hospital on the news?

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: Oh, dear. I'm afraid everyone was[n]thinking the same thing.

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: But I knew you weren't capable of[n]doing those terrible things.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Wh-What's going on?

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: Oh, my. You really don't know, do you?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Chief of Staff Oyamada turned himself in.[n]He was manipulating things behind the[n]scenes.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Turns out he was the one who made that[n]terrible medical error, and laid the blame[n]on his subordinate!

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Chief of Staff Oyamada turned himself in.[n]He was manipulating things behind the[n]scenes.

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Turns out he was the one who made that[n]terrible medical error, and laid the blame[n]on his subordinate!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Is that... true?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: It's been on news channels all[n]over the country!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I haven't... seen it...

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: I just knew something didn't quite[n]add up about that story.

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: I never believed someone like you could[n]have ever done something like that.

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: Hooray! Doctor!

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: But... What's a medical error?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What? Um... It's something that[n]shouldn't be allowed to happen...[n]I guess.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Is this all some elaborate joke?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Oyamada surrendering himself... [n]at such a convenient time... Why...?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...It doesn't matter. It's too late.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It doesn't change the fact that[n]I couldn't save her...
Miwa-chan is alive.
Oyamada lied to you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: What...!?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: There's... no way...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Did the news mention anything about[n]the patient involved in the medical error[n]incident!?

entries.speaker: Girl's Father
entries.en: Oh, it must've been difficult for her too.[n]I heard she's been moved to another[n]hospital...

entries.speaker: Old Lady
entries.en: What's the matter, dear?

entries.speaker: Sick Girl
entries.en: Are you okay, Doctor!?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: So she's... she's alive...
You should hurry.
Let's get to work, Doctor.[clr 27]
It's not over yet.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Ah, yeah, you're right!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Yes, of course!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Yes, you're right... I have to finish what I[n]started.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You'll help me, right? I take[n]back what I said. We'll resume[n]development right away.
It feels like my bond with Takemi[n]is growing even deeper...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: We're going to move quickly today,[n]so you may experience some[n]pain during the examination.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Sorry. Just hang in there, okay?
It's for Miwa-chan.[clr 27]
It's for my exams.
It's for you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Thank you. You're... a good guy.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Once the medicine is perfected, [n]I'll introduce you to Miwa-chan [n]and tell her how much you helped.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Entrance exams? Oh, was that [n]what this was all for?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Well, whatever you say.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hehe. Well, aren't you a smooth talker.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: All right, into the examination[n]room you go.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That's all for today. Take care.
